title: Art. 3.33.2 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 3 - Entry and Departure of Persons and Their Baggage, H. Inspection of travel documents, 3.33.2
content: Contracting States shall not require aircraft operators to seize documents referred to in Standard 3.33.1.
